title: HTML & CSS: Structure and Style of Web Pages
learning_objectives: Describe the role of HTML in defining document structure
Describe the role of CSS in styling HTML documents
Build a simple static page using common HTML tags
Apply basic CSS rules to change layout, color, and typography
outline: HTML as the structure of a page
Common tags: headings, paragraphs, links, lists, images
CSS as the style layer: selectors, properties, and values
Connecting CSS to HTML: inline, internal, external
Hands-on: build a simple one-page personal profile

format: Static HTML page with at least: heading, paragraph, link, image, list
CSS file that changes colors, fonts, and spacing

constraints_for_professor: Use only a local HTML file opened in the browser
Focus on mental models and visual feedback, not pixel-perfect design
